dct_description_sm: We developed a stochastic microsimulation model to estimate the impacts of screening with multicancer early detection tests on future cancer incidence and outcomes. The dataset contains model predictions as R objects and code to generate the figures and tables in the paper "Assessing potential screening harms from overdiagnosis and false positives with multicancer early detection tests", to be submitted for publication.
dct_title_s: Replication Data and Code for: Assessing potential screening harms from overdiagnosis and false positives with multicancer early detection tests
